name: Monterrei
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A DO in the southeast corner of Ourense province in Galicia. Its zone takes in all or part of eight municipalities, including Verín. Allowed grapes include Godello, Albariño and Treixadura for white, and Mencía for red.
